# `inventory-site` commands

## `inventory-site activate`

Make an inactive site available again for stock lines and transfers.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/inventory-site.activate` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow inventory-site activate "Van 1" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Back in service" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "inventory-site activate", "input": {"site": "Van 1"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `site` | `SITE` | string | yes | no | — | Site ID or name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

## `inventory-site create`

Add an inventory site, as the anchor's Advanced Inventory sites do: a warehouse, a staging area, a service van, a consignment location or goods on the water. The stock at a site is the company's own. Every company starts with one site, Main, the default; stock lines that name no site are placed at the default. is_default true makes the new site the default instead. Example: `bookflow inventory-site create --name "Van 1" --description "Ford Transit, plumber 1"`.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/inventory-site.create` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow inventory-site create --name "Van 1" --description "Service van" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Track the van stock" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "inventory-site create", "input": {"name": "Van 1", "description": "Service van"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `--name` | string | yes | no | — | Site name, such as "Warehouse" or "Van 1"; unique.; minimum length 1; maximum length 200 |
| `description` | `--description` | string \| null | no | yes | null | What or where the site is. |
| `address` | `--address` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Postal address of the site, as free text. |
| `is_default` | `--is-default` | boolean | no | no | false | Make this the default site: stock lines naming no site are placed here. |
| `tracks_bins` | `--tracks-bins` | boolean | no | no | false | Locate stock at this site to bins (add them with `bin create`). |

## `inventory-site deactivate`

Make a site inactive so new stock lines and transfers cannot name it. Refused (E_RECORD_IN_USE, naming the items) while it holds any stock; transfer it out first. The default site cannot be deactivated.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

## `inventory-site show`

Show a site with each item it holds (on hand, as of today or as_of) and its latest transfers in and out.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | read |
| Required role | member |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/inventory-site.show` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow inventory-site show "Van 1" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:


### Input

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `site` | `SITE` | string | yes | no | — | Site ID or name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `as_of` | `--as-of` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Stock as of this date; omitted, today. |

### Command and context options

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print one JSON object. |
| `--data-root TEXT` | Data root; otherwise `BOOKFLOW_DATA_ROOT`, then `~/.bookflow`. |
| `--company TEXT` | Company id, `Organization/Company`, or display name. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/inventory-site.show`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |

| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |

| `description` | string \| null | yes | yes | — | — |

## `inventory-site update`

Rename a site (renaming Main is an ordinary update), change its description or address, or make it the default (is_default true); the old default stops being it.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | item |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/inventory-site.update` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow inventory-site update Main --name Warehouse --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --reason "Name the default site" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "inventory-site update", "input": {"site": "Main", "name": "Warehouse"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `site` | `SITE` | string | yes | no | — | Site ID or name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `expected_version` | `--expected-version` | integer \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `name` | `--name` | string \| null | no | yes | null | New name; renaming Main is an ordinary update. |
| `description` | `--description` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `address` | `--address` | string \| null | no | yes | null | — |
| `is_default` | `--is-default` | literal[true] \| null | no | yes | null | true makes this the default site (the previous default stops being it). |
| `tracks_bins` | `--tracks-bins` | boolean \| null | no | yes | null | true locates stock here to bins; false is refused while any bin holds stock. |
